purpose: Official AC38 rule source pinning; downloaded bytes do not resolve clause interpretation or effective dates.

sources.effective_date_note: Initial conditions posted; amendments/sailing instructions pending prior to Cup.

verified_scoring_clauses.RRSAC 107, page 32: Fleet series points ties use latest common scheduled finishing places, then earlier races.
verified_scoring_clauses.RRSAC 101.2, page 29: Only completed rounds between all Challengers count; exclude Defender results for Challenger qualification.
verified_scoring_clauses.RRSAC 102.1, page 30: Wording references first/last Challenger and three-/four-Challenger cases; six-Challenger seeding remains unresolved.
verified_scoring_clauses.RRSAC 101.3 and 102.4, pages 29 and 31: CSS knockouts may use last-day score and tie procedure; Cup Match has no tie break.
verified_scoring_clauses.Protocol Article 22.1(d), page 19: 5 crew members with at least 1 female sailor; optional non-contributing Guest Racer in addition.
verified_scoring_clauses.Protocol Article 22.1(e), page 19: Manual power input prohibited except steering; battery-powered system mimicking 4 human cyclors in average/peak power and fatigue.
verified_scoring_clauses.Protocol Article 24.2(b), page 20: AC37 competitors must reuse AC37 hull (or build to AC37 design if unavailable); New Competitors must acquire AC37 hull or build to AC37 design. No new hull designs.
verified_scoring_clauses.Conditions 4.5 & 4.6, pages 1-2: Top 3 Challengers from Group Stage 2 progress to Semi-Finals; 4th, 5th, 6th compete in Group Stage 3 Repêchage (6th vs 5th with +1 to 5th, winner vs 4th with +1 to 4th).
verified_scoring_clauses.RRSAC 102.1 & 102.3, pages 30-31: CSS round-robin ties only broken for first and last placed Challenger. Broken by sail-off (102.1(a)) or 102.3 hierarchy: head-to-head match score, last match, points against top other boat, prior regatta standing, draw.

effective_date_note: PDF creation metadata is not an effective date. Verified effective dates and underlying instructions remain publication prerequisites.

rules_precedence.stated_precedence: Rules Committee official GitHub releases take precedence over noticeboard text summaries; PDF creation metadata is never an effective date.

unresolved_clauses: Six-challenger qualification/seeding tie procedure requires authoritative clarification (RRSAC 102.1 only covers 3- and 4-Challenger ties).
Timing-dependent shared/zero-score results require the applicable race state and instructions.
Incomplete-series, withdrawal and continuation instructions must be pinned before publication.
Protocol Amendment 08 notes Article 13.2 rule number reference remains under review.
